capabilities: Preview local source file lines on hover via #L18-style links
Fetch GitHub and GitLab blob links at their raw URLs and display them
Show a web page section selected by heading fragment ranges
Syntax-highlight previewed code by file extension
Configure the modifier key that triggers hover previews
disambiguation: Not a code navigation or execution tool; it only renders a link's target in a hover panel.
extras: Desktop only (reads files through Node's filesystem API); manual installation from release files; pages rendered by JavaScript cannot be previewed; the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's page preview only resolves vault notes, so links to source files or external pages give no inline preview and force you to leave the note.

relations.evidence: The plugin matches it deliberately, so your muscle memory carries over.

summary: Hover-preview plugin that shows what code and web links point at: lines of a local source file, a repository file, or a web page heading.
